visualCharacteristics.purpose: Multi-column card grid with an optional heading/intro row; the Style option picks the card treatment
visualCharacteristics.description: solutions: bordered 3-up cards with image, category eyebrow, title, Learn More link. productlines: white cards on a grey band. insights: intro panel beside stacked text cards. simple: 4-up cards with tag pill and NEW ribbon. features: centered borderless 3-up columns (title, icon, description) on a lavender band. features-purple: same layout as features on a full-width purple #811167 band with white heading, titles, descriptions and white line icons. video: 3-up 16:9 Vidyard posters with a play overlay, no text body; clicking inlines the player. showcase: white cards over a full-bleed background image with a centered white heading/subheading; cards with or without images and a Learn more button. products: 4-up (wrapping) white square-cornered cards with a soft 0 2px 2px shadow, image on top, optional light-blue #d8e3f7 tag pill, 28px light title, 14px description and a blue "Learn more >" chevron link; sits in a highlight section. photo: 3-up white photo cards with a 0 2px 2px shadow and 5px hover lift, image on top, centred 30px light title and 18px description, blue "Explore >" chevron link; no background band. accent: white text-only cards with a 4px brand-red top border and thin grey border, left-aligned 16px bold red title, 14px description and an optional outlined red pill link; 1-up mobile, 2-up from 600px. icons: no card chrome, 64-80px icon on top, bold centred 18px title, left-aligned 16px text; 1-up / 2-up (600px) / 4-up (900px).

contentPattern.structure: row 0 = heading/intro (rich text; showcase: optional heading + subheading and optional background image, in the heading row or the container Background Image field); rows 1..N = one card each: image cell + rich text cell (title, description, link). video: poster image + paragraph with a link to the video (link text = video title). features/features-purple: card title is a heading or a leading bold-only paragraph; it renders above the icon. products/photo: optional heading row (no image, no link); each card = image cell + text cell (products: optional tag paragraph before the H3 title, description, link-only paragraph for the Learn more link; photo: H3 title, description, link-only paragraph). accent/icons: optional single-cell heading row; each card = image cell (accent: usually empty; icons: the icon) + rich text cell (title = first heading or a leading bold-only paragraph, description, accent: trailing link-only paragraph = pill link)

usage.description: Home, About Us, Products and Chemistry pages (solutions, productlines, insights, simple, features); Host Response to Infection solution page (features, video, showcase). Advanced Informatics product page (products, photo).

reuseGuidance: Use for multi-column card grids. Use cards-media-list for vertical image-left/text-right resource lists. Use carousel resources when cards must be filterable and paged.
